quiz.question: Molekulyar darajada tovuq qaysi qadimgi jonzotga eng yaqin tirik qarindosh hisoblanadi?
quiz.explanation: 68 million yoshli Tiranozavr suyagidagi oqsil tahlili uning molekulyar tuzilishiga eng yaqin tirik jonzot tovuq ekanini ko'rsatgan.
